entries.title: Optional water level passed to formatter
entries.root_cause: The gauge renderer passes an optional water level to format_level, which requires a float. The call must handle the missing value before formatting.

entries.title: Package index hostname cannot be resolved
entries.root_cause: The runner cannot resolve the configured internal Python package index hostname, so dependency installation fails. Restoring DNS or correcting the index address is required.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Installation fails on DNS resolution before static checks run; this is independent of the renderer type error.
